continuationGovernor.stopReason: OWNER_REQUIRED represents standing production side-effect gates, not a current engineering stop. Consumer-readiness CR-25 log privacy, CR-24 Safepay readiness parity, CR-05 destination-aware shipping and CR-07/CR-09 unified Issue access/recovery are integrated through exact migration head 25495afe78efcb4d0cfebf8917eae1f152c5317f. CR-07/CR-09 passed exact feature and post-merge CI plus Browser QA; no production deployment/environment mutation was performed. CR-05 and CR-07/CR-09 remain CODE_READY until their required deployed/live consumer proofs exist. The next autonomous code-side target from the canonical consumer-readiness master plan is CR-11 public encrypted Issue-scoped support. Temporary support values remain test configuration only; merchant public location remains deliberately deferred and must not be fabricated. Production referral migrations and Hostinger environment/branch mutations remain separately owner-gated.

rules: Treat feat/mystery-foundation as canonical until final release promotion.
Require fresh CI, Browser QA when path-applicable, exact release health, live-product and database evidence before launch-success claims.
Never expose encryption keys, OTPs, sessions, raw answers, addresses, database credentials, payment secrets or provider secrets.
Do not rotate QUIZ_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V2 or IDENTITY_HMAC_KEY without an explicit continuity plan.
Do not mutate frozen release candidate branches.
Do not change the current Hostinger hPanel branch selection; prior branch changes reset environment variables.
Keep Printful production confirmation disabled until the explicit manufacturing launch gate.
Do not create real Safepay charges solely for QA.
Do not apply referral migrations 0029, 0034 or 0035 to production without explicit production referral-activation approval.

Do not send creator launch outreach until referral migrations are live, the intended creator roster is reviewed, provider email configuration is green and the Owner explicitly triggers /ops/referral-launch.
Do not cut issuedonce.shop until all temporary-host provider, customer-flow and email-deliverability gates are green.
Treat temporary support mailbox values as test configuration only; do not claim production support identity or live delivery until provider and mailbox evidence exists.
Do not add or fabricate MERCHANT_PUBLIC_LOCATION while the owner has deferred location; require a truthful value before canonical launch.
Use docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-31-issued-once-consumer-readiness-master-plan.md as the canonical consumer-readiness ledger and update it after each meaningful CR cycle.

issueAccessRecovery.securityFindingAndFix: Pre-merge review proved provider tracker/payment truth alone must not mint browser ownership.
